title: Verify checker spec
description: The checker of VerifyGenerateAndCheck: one JSON object (not JSON lines). A taskset line without index/stdin/suite, plus the verdict rule at the top level. Every candidate that passed generation with output becomes one run of this program with the candidate's stdout on stdin, under the candidate's index.

entry.description: The checker's entry file. Defaults to the first source.

expected_stdout.description: The exact stdout of a passing check (the recommended contract: the checker prints its verdict and exits 0, so a crash stays distinguishable as a RuntimeError). Absent = only the exit code counts.

expected_exit.description: The exit code of a passing check.
